disruptions.title: Ice storm: Northgate Pass (Highway N-7) closed
disruptions.impact: N-7 closed with chain controls; trucks held at Ashford Vale or rerouted via the R-12 southern corridor (+5 h)

disruptions.title: Port Calder Terminal 2: crane outage and vessel bunching
disruptions.impact: Average discharge delay 3.5 days; vessel Bluefin Aurora (voyage 044E) at anchor since 2026-11-03

disruptions.title: Ironbridge Freight: Coast region driver shortage
disruptions.impact: LTL capacity down about 30%; 2 of 5 tenders rejected on 2026-11-05

disruptions.title: Redmarsh DC: 4-hour WMS outage backlog
disruptions.impact: 1,800 order lines behind; outbound waves 6-10 h late; night-shift overtime awaiting approval

disruptions.title: Customs hold: HS code mismatch on one import
disruptions.impact: Container held pending a corrected commercial invoice from the supplier
